annotations.title: Widen, halt or finish a Google Play rollout

description: Asks a person to approve a change to an Android release's staged rollout on production (or the track it's on): increase to a bigger percentage, halt it (people who have it keep it; no one new gets it), resume a halted one at a percentage, or complete it (everyone). Use it when ploa_quality shows crashes or ANRs rising after a release (halt), or when the rollout looks healthy (increase or complete). Nothing changes on Google Play until a person approves (an autonomous agent's request goes straight through); follow the answer with ploa_approval_status. A first rollout to production is ploa_release_promote. For the App Store's phased release use ploa_appstore_phased_release.

percent.description: For increase and resume: the share of users, 1 to 99 (complete is 100).

releaseId.description: The release ID that ploa_release_start returned.
